Sarasota-Area Museums — December 2026

Updated Friday, November 27, 2026, 7:26 AM ET

Summary

Summary

December is the busiest month of the season. Holiday lights, Santa and music join a full slate of exhibitions. Here are the standouts:

  • Holiday lights: Selby’s Lights in Bloom® (more than 2 million lights) runs most nights Dec 5–30 from 5:30 PM. The Florida Railroad Museum’s North Pole Express runs Dec 2–22 from Parrish. The Ringling has two Holiday Splendor nights (Dec 10 and 17, free with a toy) and Holiday Nights on the Bayfront, with projections on Ca’ d’Zan (Dec 29–30).
  • Santa and holiday fun: A Visit with Santa at The Ringling (Sat Dec 5, free). Palmetto’s free Christmas in the Park (Dec 4–5). The Herrig Center’s Art of the Season tree display (Dec 2–21). The Lemon Bay Historical Society’s holiday sing-along (Dec 15).
  • Music and theater: Valerie June at Ca’ d’Zan’s Bolger Campiello (Dec 18, $50). National Theatre Live: Golden Boy at the Historic Asolo Theater (Dec 3–4). SAM’s Jazz Thursday (Dec 17). Ringling by the Bay (Dec 28).
  • New to see: The Ringling opens Seba Calfuqueo: TRAY TRAY KO on Dec 19. It also offers nine sunset Skyspace programs and Uncovering Ca' d'Zan tours most weekends. SAM’s Precession Through Glass is new, and its Free Second Sunday is Dec 13. Art Center Sarasota opens its Juried Members Show on Dec 3, and the Venice Art Center opens Sweet Dreams on Dec 8.
  • For kids: Mote SEA has Winter Break Day Camps, Breakfast with the Sharks (Dec 26) and Noon Year's Eve (Dec 31). The Bishop has The Alien Who Stole Christmas and Tales Under the Tree. SAM has a snow-globe workshop (Dec 22), and Crowley hosts a family campout (Dec 12–13).
  • New Year’s Eve: Selby’s black-tie New Year's Eve Gala (details not yet posted) and Mote’s Noon Year's Eve.

Christmas Day closes almost everything: The Ringling, SAM, both Selby campuses, The Bishop, Jungle Gardens, De Soto and the Gamble Plantation visitor center. The Bishop also closes Dec 24 and 31. The Venice Art Center closes Dec 23–27 and Dec 31. See holiday closures for details. The Florida Maritime Museum stays closed all month.

  • Closed: The Bishop Museum of Science and Nature, Venice Art Center
  • Changed hours: The Ringling — closes 5 PM; Marie Selby Botanical Gardens — Historic Spanish Point — open 10 AM–3 PM; Marie Selby Botanical Gardens — Downtown Sarasota — gardens open; no Lights in Bloom
  • Normally open that day, but no holiday hours posted: Anna Maria Island Historical Museum, Art Center Sarasota, Herrig Center for the Arts, Manatee Village Historical Park, Marietta Museum of Art & Whimsy, Mote Science Education Aquarium (Mote SEA), Palmetto Historical Park, Venice Museum & Archives (Venice History Museum)

Christmas Day, Fri, Dec 25

  • Closed: The Bishop Museum of Science and Nature, De Soto National Memorial, Gamble Plantation Historic State Park, Marie Selby Botanical Gardens — Downtown Sarasota, Marie Selby Botanical Gardens — Historic Spanish Point, The Ringling, Sarasota Art Museum, Sarasota Jungle Gardens, Venice Art Center
  • Normally open that day, but no holiday hours posted: Anna Maria Island Historical Museum, Art Center Sarasota, Herrig Center for the Arts, Manatee Village Historical Park, Marietta Museum of Art & Whimsy, Mote Science Education Aquarium (Mote SEA), Palmetto Historical Park, Venice Museum & Archives (Venice History Museum)

New Year’s Eve, Thu, Dec 31

  • Closed: The Bishop Museum of Science and Nature, Venice Art Center
  • Changed hours: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens — Downtown Sarasota — gardens open by day; no Lights in Bloom; New Year’s Eve Gala at night
  • Normally open that day, but no holiday hours posted: Anna Maria Island Historical Museum, Art Center Sarasota, Herrig Center for the Arts, Manatee Village Historical Park, Marietta Museum of Art & Whimsy, Mote Science Education Aquarium (Mote SEA), Palmetto Historical Park, Venice Museum & Archives (Venice History Museum)

Other December closures

  • Venice Art Center: closed Dec 23–27 and Dec 31.
  • Art Center Sarasota: galleries closed until the Juried Members Show opens on Dec 3.
  • Historic Venice Train Depot: closed Wed Dec 2 for the society’s holiday luncheon.
  • The Bishop: closed Mondays. Crowley: open weekends only. Marietta Museum: Thu–Sat only.
  • Lights in Bloom®: closed Dec 24, 25 and 31; it returns Jan 1–2, 2027.
  • Florida Maritime Museum: closed all month for building rehabilitation.
